answer: Each identity must hold one registered charity trusteeship, checked with the charity regulator: appointment, public register entry and annual accounts match, and one trusteeship backs one identity only. A river-cleanup charity seats only vetted trustees. Each fake costs one vetted trustee, 900 units in fees and 90 days to be appointed; 100 fakes cost 90,000 units and 100 trustees. An appointment they forge fails the register check, a whisper of shared control triggers an audit that merges and suspends both identities, and a trustee fronting for a farm faces liability and disqualification.
